meta.name: add-linear
meta.description: Add Linear channel integration via Chat SDK. Issue comment threads as conversations.

copy.tagline: 将 Linear 工单评论转为聊天会话
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果团队用 Linear 管理任务并希望直接在聊天中跟进评论。
copy.tagline_en: Turn Linear issue comments into chat conversations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your team uses Linear for task management and wants to follow up comments in chat.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude会监控指定的Linear团队，自动回复该团队所有issue上的每条评论，无需@提及；每个issue的评论线程被当作一个独立对话。
howto.when: 当已配置的Linear团队中的任何issue出现新评论时触发，webhook自动通知，无需@提及。

say.note: Claude将开始执行Linear适配器集成步骤。

say.text: 把ENG团队的评论接给代理A
say.note: Claude会为ENG团队创建消息组并接线到指定代理。
Claude会执行集成测试以确认适配器正常。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude monitors the configured Linear team and automatically replies to every comment on its issues without @-mention. Each issue's comment thread is treated as a separate conversation.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a new comment is posted on any issue in the configured Linear team. The webhook notifies the agent automatically; no @-mention is required.

say_en.note: Claude will start the Linear adapter integration steps.

say_en.text: Route ENG team comments to agent A.
say_en.note: Claude will create a messaging group and wiring for the ENG team.
Claude will run the integration test to confirm the adapter works.
